name: ArithmeticFunction
vonMangoldt
LSeries_residueClass_lower_bound
result.signature:
(ha : IsUnit a) :
  ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ {x : ℝ} (_ : x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2), (q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ / (x - 1) - C ≤ ∑' n, residueClass a n / (n : ℝ) ^ x
result.type:
∀ {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] {a : ZMod q},
  IsUnit a →
    ∃ C,
      ∀ {x : ℝ},
        x ∈ Set.Ioc 1 2 →
          (↑q.totient)⁻¹ / (x - 1) - C ≤ ∑' (n : ℕ), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt.residueClass a n / ↑n ^ x
result.value:
:=
  by
  have H {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) :
    ∑' n, residueClass a n / (n : ℝ) ^ x = (LFunctionResidueClassAux a x).re + (q.totient : ℝ)⁻¹ / (x - 1) :=
    by
    refine ofReal_injective ?_
    simp only [ofReal_tsum, ofReal_div, ofReal_cpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _), ofReal_natCast, ofReal_add, ofReal_inv,
      ofReal_sub, ofReal_one]
    simp_rw [← LFunctionResidueClassAux_real ha hx,
      eqOn_LFunctionResidueClassAux ha <| Set.mem_setOf.mpr (ofReal_re x ▸ hx), sub_add_cancel, LSeries, term]
   ...
result.informal_name: Lower Bound for Dirichlet Series of Von Mangoldt Function in Residue Class
result.informal_description: For a unit $a$ modulo $q$, there exists a constant $C$ such that for all $x$ in the interval $(1, 2]$, the Dirichlet series $\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\Lambda_{a,q}(n)}{n^x}$ satisfies $\frac{1}{\varphi(q)(x - 1)} - C \leq \sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{\Lambda_{a,q}(n)}{n^x}$, where $\Lambda_{a,q}(n)$ is the von Mangoldt function restricted to integers $n \equiv a \mod q$ and $\varphi(q)$ is Euler's totient function.

name: BoundingSieve
weights
result.informal_description: A function that assigns real number weights to natural numbers, associated with a bounding sieve in Selberg sieve theory, used to estimate the size of sifted sets of integers.

name: BoundingSieve
nu_pos_of_prime
result.signature: ∀ (self : BoundingSieve) (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ self.prodPrimes → 0 < self.nu p
result.type: ∀ (self : BoundingSieve) (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ∣ self.prodPrimes → 0 < self.nu p
result.informal_name: Positivity of ν at Primes in the Bounding Sieve
result.informal_description: For any bounding sieve and any prime $ p $ dividing the product of its associated primes, the arithmetic function $ \nu $ satisfies $ 0 < \nu(p) $.

name: Nat
infinite_setOf_prime_and_modEq
result.signature: {q a : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : a.Coprime q) : Set.Infinite {p : ℕ | p.Prime ∧ p ≡ a [MOD q]}
result.type: ∀ {q a : ℕ}, q ≠ 0 → a.Coprime q → {p | Nat.Prime p ∧ p ≡ a [MOD q]}.Infinite
result.informal_name: Dirichlet's Theorem on Primes in Arithmetic Progressions
result.informal_description: For any positive integer $ q $ and integer $ a $ coprime to $ q $, the set of primes congruent to $ a $ modulo $ q $ is infinite.

name: Nat
forall_exists_prime_gt_and_zmodEq
result.signature: (n : ℕ) {q : ℕ} {a : ℤ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (h : IsCoprime a q) : ∃ p > n, p.Prime ∧ p ≡ a [ZMOD q]
result.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) {q : ℕ} {a : ℤ}, q ≠ 0 → IsCoprime a ↑q → ∃ p > n, Nat.Prime p ∧ ↑p ≡ a [ZMOD ↑q]
result.value:
:= by
  have : NeZero q := ⟨hq⟩
  have : IsUnit (a : ZMod q) := by rwa [ZMod.coe_int_isUnit_iff_isCoprime, isCoprime_comm]
  obtain ⟨p, hpn, hpp, heq⟩ := forall_exists_prime_gt_and_eq_mod this n
  refine ⟨p, hpn, hpp, ?_⟩
  simpa [← ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff] using heq
result.informal_name: Existence of Primes Greater Than $ n $ in the Arithmetic Progression $ a \mod q $
result.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $, non-zero natural number $ q $, and integer $ a $ coprime to $ q $, there exists a prime number $ p $ greater than $ n $ such that $ p \equiv a \pmod{q} $.
